author: Gilmo
quote: This game currently has way too many bugs, which completely ruins the overall player experience. On top of that, the performance is locked at a choppy 30 FPS, making the gameplay feel very sluggish and unresponsive. Instead of exciting action, it honestly feels like a boring house simulator where you spend all your time decorating rather than actually playing. The developers seriously need to fix these major issues before I can ever recommend it today.

author: Gilmo
quote:
Nicht Empfehlenswert !
Das Spiel hat 40 € gekostet und war mit denn Vorgänger Teilen nicht vergleichbar.
